column1: # Claude Code plugins that must be installed on EVERY toolkit machine.
# One plugin per line, three TAB-separated fields:
# Blank lines and `#` comments are ignored. `bin/ai-claude-plugins` adds the
# marketplace (when the machine does not know it yet) and installs
# `plugin@marketplace` at USER scope, so its skills appear in every project as
# Additive only: deleting a line stops the install on new machines; machines
# that already have the plugin keep it (`claude plugin uninstall` removes it).
# Cost to weigh before adding a line: a plugin that ships an MCP server starts
# that server in EVERY Claude Code session on the machine (see
# publisher's default branch; read the source before adding one here.
# ScaleDown SLM Agent (owner request 2026-11-18): `/slm-agent:evaluate` scans a
# codebase for LLM calls that a cheaper task-specific ScaleDown model can
# replace, `/slm-agent:optimize` tunes the replacement prompt. Ships one local
# stdio MCP server (`npx -y @scaledown/migration-agent`); source read at commit
